justification: The endpoint assay achieved all three activity targets and showed lower reconstruction error but budget- and time-scale-dependent entropy proximity. Test reproducibility with independent training rather than treating repeated tests as trained networks.
network: 60 excitatory and 15 inhibitory neurons, three-dimensional input, the same local weight-update equations and constants as the archived 300+75 network. This is an explicit reduced-network experiment, not a replay of independent original-size trainings.
budget: Total E+I activity, one cost unit per spike; the same closed-loop threshold controller operates throughout learning and evaluation. This is not an independently calibrated metabolic energy budget.
training_input_bank: 128 independently generated 100-ms three-component smoothed-Gaussian templates per training seed, drawn with replacement in 100-ms blocks. Banks/initializations/noise seeds are paired across budgets, and independent across the eight training seeds.
decoder: Centered ridge decoder, leave-one-calibration-template-out alpha selection on the same fixed grid as controlled_protocol.json, independent held-out test stimuli. Separate decoder fitted at every checkpoint.
control: The initial weights with plasticity disabled, evaluated under the same budget controller, inputs, noise seeds, burn-in and readout protocol. Evaluation resets dynamical state, so running unchanged weights through a long unobserved training interval would not alter this counterfactual.
primary_response: All-cell non-overlapping 1-s counts on common fixed support, equally weighted over cells/templates/repeats. E-only and I-only checks retained.
primary_outcome: Final-minus-initial equal-cost Gibbs entropy deficit, with actual achieved mean count used to define each reference.
functional_outcome: Final-minus-initial held-out waveform reconstruction error at matched total activity.
inference: Training seed is the independent unit. Use exact two-sided paired sign-flip tests on the eight seed effects, Holm correction across the three budgets separately within entropy and reconstruction outcomes. Secondary time scales remain descriptive, not replacement primary outcomes.
uncertainty: Paired training-seed bootstrap intervals for endpoint mean differences, 10000 draws; test repeats are averaged within a training seed.
feasibility: Require finite weights/readouts, sign constraints, simulator validation and achieved evaluation budgets within 5% of target. Report any failure without selectively dropping seeds.
stop_rule: Run the fixed cohort/duration; no extension to obtain significance and no cost/window selection to obtain universal convergence. No general convergence theorem or global reconstruction optimum is claimed.
